name: Quantum Love Theory
source:
You and a team of physicists are working on an interdimensional worlds connection device. One day, you decide to test the machine by yourself, but things go wrong due to its experimental nature.

You wake up in a parallel universe where everyone you know has lived a different life and now has new personalities and relationships. To find your way back, you’ll need the help of these familiar strangers.

[From [url=https://darknessminotaur.itch.io/quantumlove]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你和一个物理学家团队正在研究一个跨维度世界的连接设备。有一天，你决定亲自测试这台机器，但由于其实验性质，出现了问题。

你在一个平行宇宙中醒来，你认识的每个人都过着不同的生活，现在都有新的个性和关系。为了找到回去的路，你需要这些熟悉的陌生人的帮助。

[来自[url=https://darknessminotaur.itch.io/quantumlove]Itch.io[/url]]
